answer: Bind each agent key to a distinct payment instrument: to forge a reward share, an identity must keep a small monthly fee flowing from a card or bank account whose issuer fingerprint is unique. The ledger keeps an atlas of hashed instrument fingerprints, never raw numbers; two keys paid from one source merge into one share. A sybil farm of 1,000 clones then needs 1,000 separately verified accounts, a steady river of fees and KYC exposure for each.
